name: Gudbrand-on-the-Slope
description: A well-meaning farmer who cheerfully trades his way home and trusts that his wife will see the good in it.
visualPrompt: A sturdy, middle-aged Scandinavian farmer with a weathered, kind face, simple wool tunic and trousers, knitted cap, sturdy boots, carrying a small pouch from the road, relaxed posture and faint grin

name: Gudbrand's Wife
description: Practical and remarkably supportive, she praises each decision and turns every loss into a blessing.
visualPrompt: A middle-aged Scandinavian farmwife with bright, confident eyes and a welcoming expression, wearing a long homespun dress with apron and shawl, hair covered with a simple headscarf, hands poised as if calling the children to bring the animal in

name: The Neighbor
description: A skeptical local farmer who wagers that Gudbrand’s wife will finally scold him—and listens outside the door to find out.
visualPrompt: A lean, wary farmer in plain rustic clothing and a wool cloak, standing just outside a farmhouse door, brows raised in disbelief, hands clasped as if counting a wager

name: The Children
description: Their unseen chorus in the home, repeatedly sent out to bring in each new animal that never arrives.
visualPrompt: Two or three farm children in simple linen shirts and wool vests, curious and eager, hovering near the doorway with playful, expectant faces
